problems: The Elenchus prints NO columns anywhere in this volume; every column rests on the body, cross-checked against the closing Ordo.

The Elenchus ends at the Pars Tertia heading and three editorial items; the individual Vitae Sanctorum (cols 306-1464, listed with columns in the Ordo) are not Elenchus items and are not itemised here. A work-level pass over them needs the Ordo list.
The last Elenchus line before the Praefatio ('ee saehotoram: PR ic') is OCR garble and was not read as an item.
Ordo lists Indices in Diatribam (147) which the Elenchus omits; entered as body-only.
Several Ordo columns land one page off the body for items on shared spreads (Sermones 219 vs body 217|218; Alphabeta unlisted); bodyCol follows the body.
Elenchus says 'Sermones Ethici XXV'; the body head says XXIV and the crossref OCR reads tom. XXXII col. 1115. Macarius crossref column OCR is unreliable ('84.-965').
Page numbers for spreads are often missing in the OCR; where a spread was inferred (19|20, 209|210, 225|226) the entry says so.

Parts of Vitae Sanctorum taken from the closing Ordo, which in the OCR lists only Mensis Januarius and Februarius (to Die 18, col 1451) and then ends at FINIS TOMI; later months are not in the Ordo OCR and are not entered. Ordo columns are as read and several are garbled or out of order (e.g. 135, 151, 400, 011, '1', 1714, 1315); none body-confirmed.
